passage.title: Forces on a Roller Coaster
paragraphs: Roller coasters are a good place to experience different forces. First you go up a steep hill. The roller coaster goes slow. Next, gravity pulls you down the hill. The roller coaster moves fast. You feel very light!

The roller coaster uses friction to stop. If it stops quickly, your body wants to continue moving. That is called inertia. But the safety bars keep you in place! Not everyone loves roller coasters. They make some people feel dizzy or sick because the forces change.

questions.stem: You can experience many forces on a roller coaster ride.

The different forces on a roller coaster can make you dizzy.

passage.title: Friction, Centripetal Force, and Gravity
paragraphs: Forces like friction, centripetal force, and gravity are things we experience every day. You feel centripetal force when you turn on a skateboard, you feel friction when you use your feet to slow or stop the skateboard, and you feel gravity when you jump with your skateboard and come down.

Friction, centripetal force, and gravity are also part of jumping rope. The more you move a jumping rope up and down and around and around in circles, the more centripetal force is created. When the rope moves up, gravity pulls down on the jumping rope, moving it in the opposite direction. When the rope moves down, gravity helps the rope keep moving in that direction. When you jump over the rope, you’re also feeling gravity. Gravity brings you back to the ground after you jump. When you’re jumping rope, friction is created when the rope and your hands meet. Friction is also created between the rope and the floor, and the rope and the air. Friction slows down the movement of the rope, but as long as your hands keep turning the rope, it won’t stop the fun!

prompts.q: Where do you think these kids are?
What happens when the boy pushes more?
prompts.a: The more the boy pushes, the faster they go / the more they spin.

prompts.q: Which direction is he pushing them?
prompts.a: He is pushing them in a forward direction.

prompts.q: How can the boy make the children dizzier?

prompts.q: Gravity pulls the children when the boy pushes the ride. What is gravity?
prompts.a: Gravity is a force (which pulls you toward Earth).
